Her attitude toward students was one of the worst parts of the class. She often came across as dismissive, condescending, and unwilling to show basic respect when students had questions or concerns. I found this class to be poorly structured and unnecessarily stressful. I had an extremely negative experience in this class. One of the most disappointing professors I've had at Texas A&M. The workload is excessive, the course feels poorly organized, and expectations are often unclear. She runs this class so heavy handedly for no reason. Bubbly and supportive on the inside, sinister and unyielding within.

This seminar is a super easy A as long as you participate and complete required assignments. Although on Howdy it shows the class meets on Tuesday and Thursday, it does NOT actually meet on Thursday. Cancerous class, teaches more about micromanagement than software engineering.
